_comment: Bonus attributes a weapon can roll, for the build planner's weapon attribute picker. It is the gear attribute list (bonus-attributes.json) with the Season 2 Phase 1 change applied: Ubisoft removed the damage type bonuses (Blast, Piercing and Shredding Weapon and Skill Damage) from weapon rolls 'in favor of All Weapon Damage or All Skill Damage' (see src/content/patch-notes/season-2-phase-1-the-call.md). The new weapon MOD pool from the same patch (Weapon Damage %, Skill Intensity %, Headshot Damage %, Weapon and Skill Critical Damage %) is a different thing: those are mod rolls, not weapon rolls, and all five are already in this list. 'removed' keeps the old rolls so share links that use them still open; the planner marks them instead of counting them as current.

removed.note: no longer rolls on weapons since Season 2 Phase 1
